While many are low due to occlusion/cropping (face/front limbs), the hind limb keypoints (hips/knees/ankles) are ALSO low confidence (<0.5). This correlates with the Router's observation of ambiguous anatomy at the tail/paw interface. The topology mask is clean (0.98 confidence), which suggests the *boundary* is distinct, but the *internal structure* is mushy. I agree with the severity of 2.0 for the structural ambiguity/fusion.
